messages.content: I’ll book morning and evening battery sales, capture otherwise-curtailed midday solar, and schedule charging to meet the 125 MWh end-of-day minimum. I’ll then review each live watch through settlement.
The battery is full at 250 MWh after capturing midday solar. I’m retaining the evening sales and 22:00 recharge; the book still projects 125 MWh at day-end with no penalty.
